column1: # mtgish cross-check exclusions: the deliberate holes in the comparison.
# One line per exclusion, tab-separated:  kind<TAB>key<TAB>reason
#   kind card:  key is a card name; the card is not compared at all. Excluded
#               cards are counted and listed in the report header.
#   kind token: key is an unmapped:X spelling that is deliberately not mapped
#               Alchemy-only mechanics). A row all of whose unmapped tokens are
#               excluded is class `excluded`: it needs no ledger line, is
#               reported apart and is not counted as a gap.
# Exclude only what really cannot be compared, never what is merely tedious.
# TestMtgishLedger fails on a malformed line, an empty reason, a duplicate, or
# an exclusion that matches nothing live (stale: delete it). Never card text.

column3: Alchemy random offer (Davriel, Soul Broker): mtgish names only the offering card, the offer list is not encoded, so there is nothing to compare
Alchemy random condition (Davriel, Soul Broker): as AcceptARandomOffer, the condition list is not encoded
Conspiracy draft-matters ability (reveal or note as you draft it): acts during the draft, which neither side models in a game; Forge keeps it in Draft: lines that the card IR does not compile
Conspiracy draft-matters ability (an effect while face up during the draft): draft-time only, nothing in a game to compare; Forge Draft: lines are not compiled
Ante (target card in the ante, Darkpact): the ante zone is outside the comparison and mtgish has no target class for it
